name: Fomboni

routes.outcome: Official government portal loaded. Its service listing linked the Ministry of Economy e-Archivage (foncier) page. This is general national government discovery, not proof of a Fomboni parcel endpoint.

Official Ministry of Economy page loaded over verified TLS. It describes a platform for digitization and centralization of land titles and links to https://e-archivage.gouv.km/. No viewer JavaScript, API configuration, parcel schema, CRS, or geometry was exposed in the page content.
Host could not be resolved by the request environment (curl error 6); the web fetch also reported a 502 Bad Gateway. No login was attempted and no certificate exception was used.

Documentary source reports Fomboni consultations with the Service cadastre de Mohéli and describes a 2014 national property-registration program intended to create a cadastral/land database. It is not a current public map/API and supplied no safe parcel IDs or geometry.

viewerInspection.reason: Linked e-archivage host was unavailable; the official landing page exposed only a platform link and no client bundle or endpoint.

uncertainty: The official service listing establishes a national land-title digitization initiative, not an accessible Fomboni cadastre.
The documentary mention of Service cadastre de Mohéli does not establish a current anonymous data service.
No exact-point hit, map extent test, or citywide absence claim was made.
Runtime adapter qualification is held pending independent serial review and a real public parcel response.
